title: Import can't find module, or can't find name in module.
Base class for warnings about probable mistakes in module imports.
summary: A subclass of Warning, Exception, BaseException.

title: Check for an issue with imports.
summary: Mypy generates an error if it can't resolve an import statement. This is a parent error code of import-not-found and import-untyped. mypy enables this error code by default.

title: Check that import target can be found.
summary: Mypy generates an error if it can't find the source code or a stub file for an imported module. mypy enables this error code by default.

title: Check that import target can be found.
summary: Mypy generates an error if it can find the source code for an imported module, but that module does not provide type annotations (via PEP 561). mypy enables this error code by default.
